show.description: A disgraced ex-police trainee Ajay, forced to work as a pub bouncer to pay for his ailing mother’s treatment, becomes the bodyguard of a rich heiress Ananya—only to find himself entangled in a dangerous web of class prejudice, revenge, and forbidden love that tests his courage, pride, and heart. Watch this amazing Romantic Micro Drama "Billionaire’s Bodyguard" only on Your KUKU TV.
